result.rationale: The diff adds totalPages = Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1. When user_count is an exact multiple of limit (e.g. 100 users, limit 50), floor(100/50)+1 = 3 pages, but only 2 pages of data exist; navigating to the third page would show no members. This is a real off-by-one; correct formula is Math.ceil. Verifiable directly from the diff.
